Money.clause: currency is active in the admitted dated currency catalog
minor_units is canonical signed integer, exponent matches currency catalog; no implicit FX or rescaling

Quantity.clause: amount is an actual nonnegative decimal quantity, not a count of minor units
fractional digits <= scale; unit and scale agree for arithmetic; no floating point

TimeWindow.clause: start < end; both UTC Z instants

MoneyKnowledge.clause: observed requires nonempty actual evidence and explicit coverage; zero has minor_units=0
estimated requires a bound and assumptions; lower<=upper in same currency/exponent
unknown contains no amount and never contributes zero or available spend

MinutesKnowledge.clause: observed actual timing evidence and coverage; estimated/unknown never count as verified free attention

GroupBody.clause: changed refs and events match one exact transaction key; no self hash/Position/receipt/signature
protected records encrypted before body is persisted; complete before/after and BusinessResult committed together

CommandResult.clause: accepted requires committed_position and independent durability_receipt_ref
durability_pending cannot dispatch; duplicate retains exact original outcome/result with current restrictions separately checked

RecoveryFrontier.clause: fresh nonce/authenticated current witness query; historical capture remains evidence only

LifecycleStatus.clause: subject is neither LifecycleStatus nor an intrinsic record; ENFORCED by the subject_ref.record_type enum of every subject-taking primitive in primitive-registry.json, derived from `intrinsic: true` in record-registry.json by tools/repair_r3_intrinsic_subjects.py and re-checked by validate_contracts.py
phase and links schema match exact subject type
prior status same exact subject; current subject and prior lifecycle head CAS
supporting judgment/decision/response links must satisfy the named edge, not mere schema shape

LaunchReadiness.clause: unique complete requirement-child bijection; current exact predicates/arguments/criteria/owners; no self/circular support

RecordEnvelope.clause: recorded_at/created_event/last_event identify immutable bytes; lifecycle event refs separate
all declared refs typed and current only where explicitly required; historical existence never authority

NativeAncestry.clause: resumed context/hidden startup influence recorded or declared unknown; current tool reduction does not shrink prior disclosure

StoredRecordImage.clause: routing refs may be sensitive; plaintext allowlist requires actual scoped retention/deletion copy policy
protected business AND lifecycle bytes encrypted before GroupBody/JSONB/WAL/log/index/backup copies
